acceptanceCriteria.statement: `TaskAttemptId`, `StepAttemptId`, `RoleRunId`, and `LaunchPermitId` are distinct branded types; no public or documented generic `AttemptId` exists.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Distinct identities:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: constructors/transitions require caller-supplied timestamps, revisions, actor/reason/evidence/bundle/decision references and perform no implicit clock, ID, hash, or actor generation.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Caller-supplied scalars:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: `createRevisionEnvelope` always creates revision `0`; `validateRevisionEnvelope` accepts only non-negative safe-integer existing revisions; malformed inputs reject; outputs are defensive frozen copies; successful primitives produce exactly `revision + 1`.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Revisioned immutable envelopes:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: the exact Section 3.3 records validate as one canonical snapshot; missing/mismatched parents, duplicate/multiple ownership, invalid ordinals, parent/repository migration, missing Task ownership, and Unit repository mismatch return their frozen rejection codes.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Hierarchy invariants:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: E02 exports only `TaskAttemptId` identity/reference support; no TaskAttempt record, lifecycle, acceptance, retry, or execution matrix is present.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Deferred TaskAttempt boundary:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: every primitive returns the exact Section 3.4 discriminated union; `DomainTransitionRecord` binds the full caller context and before/after revisions; E02 failures use only the closed kernel codes and contain no partial next state or record.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Generic typed result:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: the reusable helper exercises the exact success/stale protocol and reports only the closed violation codes; it rejects changes to any attribute, undeclared dimension, or immutable/audit field other than revision and `updatedAt`.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Single-dimension helper:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section 3.2 fixtures produce byte-identical canonical text across insertion order, timezone, locale, environment, cwd, and filesystem changes; every listed invalid JSON value fails at a deterministic path.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Determinism:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: importing the public package and running canonicalization/validation/transition helpers performs no process, timer, network, filesystem, database, VCS, Beads, or Runtime effect.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Zero side effects:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: the runtime and type exports match the two exact Section 3.5 allowlists through the single package entrypoint; no public subpath, generic brand, private helper, or deferred record/lifecycle export exists.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Export boundary:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: source/export inspection permits only the E02-owned shared identity seams named by the closed scalar contract; it confirms their records/lifecycles plus supersession, plans, Readiness, projections, Attention/Blocker, Scheduling, Engineering/Task, Delivery, Release, Outcome, closure, and display remain with their named later Epics.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Scope audit:

acceptanceCriteria.statement: every Section 7 gate passes; tracked and enumerated untracked files are whitespace-clean; the generated Bundle, source/authority/renderer hashes, E01 freeze, changed-path allowlist, and exact Manifest hash read back without mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.title: Strict evidence:

metadata.title: Domain identities, hierarchy, and primitive transition kernel

included: branded identities and caller-supplied scalar references/timestamps
immutable revisioned envelopes and canonical ordering
generic expected-revision result, typed rejection, DomainTransitionRecord, and single-dimension conformance helper
deterministic zero-side-effect public exports and tests
nonGoals: TaskAttempt records or lifecycle (E79 owns these; E02 only exposes `TaskAttemptId`);
ordered plans or preflight (E73 owns these);
persistence, RPC, Beads, Git, GitHub, Runtime orchestration, Worker execution, Scheduler, Lease, Permission, adapter, network, filesystem mutation, timers, or third-party backend selection.
